purpose: Measure end-to-end useful work per launched chat, preserve explicit worker evidence when available, and keep causal post-ownership strategy metrics separate from derived launch-funnel/value observability.

slot_schema.evidence_ref: durable RETURN/guide receipt or exact artifact reference
slot_schema.experimental_slot: optional boolean; true only when this evidence-backed slot matched the enrolled job_class and was actually governed by the assigned strategy variant
slot_schema.value_class: optional PRODUCT_VALUE | SYSTEM_MULTIPLIER | CONTROL_OVERHEAD | BOUNDARY; routing/measurement metadata only, never Human Acceptance
slot_schema.successor_relay_ref: optional exact derived successor ref created from a concrete residual; absent when no relay was needed

reproduction.condition: at least one grounded successor created

breadth.condition: at least two product projects touched

anti_gaming: A slot without a durable evidence_ref scores zero.
BOUNDARY, NO_ACTION, telemetry-only, heartbeat-only and claim-only work score zero slots.
Word count and prose length are diagnostic only; they never increase score.
The scoreboard is observability, not authority and not Human Acceptance.
Pattern reproduction may guide scheduling only after authority exists; it must never add preclaim reads.
Workers must not create filler successors, visible mutations, or lower-value work merely to satisfy score components.
Retired YIELD-10X-V1 must not be newly assigned or written as pattern_id.
Post-ownership strategy evaluation must not attribute preclaim collisions/no-allocation causally to the strategy variant.
experimental_slot=true requires durable evidence and an actual governed choice in the enrolled job_class; other productive slots remain global score evidence only.
Derived launch rows must never invent experiment enrollment, strategy variant, visible change, successor creation, acceptance or Served status.
value_class is not a reward label; workers may use it only as a soft comparable-work routing preference under WORKER_GROWTH_POLICY_V1.
A successor relay counts only when a concrete non-duplicate residual job is durably materialized; no filler relay.

champion_policy.window: latest 20 closed exam cards, plus per-pool view
champion_policy.propagate_only_if: at least 3 workers independently reproduce score >=8 with the same non-null pattern_id; protocol_version is fallback only for legacy cards
champion_policy.propagation_target: worker protocol laws and allocator behavior, never worker identity/persona
champion_policy.leader_definition: highest scoring observed worker/card regardless of reproducibility
champion_policy.champion_definition: reproduced pattern meeting the independent gate; null otherwise

pattern_measurement.reproduction_grouping: pattern_id when present, otherwise protocol_version, otherwise LEGACY_UNKNOWN
pattern_measurement.truth_boundary: YIELD-10X-V1 is retired evidence. A high-scoring leader is not a champion until an actually active non-null pattern independently passes its own reproduction gate.

strategy_measurement.global_score_boundary: The existing 10-point score remains an end-to-end chat outcome and still includes low-waste preclaim behavior.
strategy_measurement.truth_boundary: Compare strategy variants only within the same job_class. Preclaim diagnostics are reported beside the sample but are not causal strategy metrics.
strategy_measurement.assignment_balance: v3.29 may use a fresh post-ownership class underrepresentation hint; hash remains tie/fallback. The chosen basis must be reconstructible.

strategy_policy.sample_ready: Both variants in a job_class have >=3 independent enrolled workers with >=1 experimental slot.

launch_measurement.rule: Every durable beacon gets a derived launch row from repository evidence even when an explicit terminal exam is missing.
